listing.name: Calendar, Timeline, Time Tracking by Planyway
listing.description:
Plan projects on a visual timeline, assign tasks to team members, manage workload and capacity, track time, and generate reports across multiple Trello boards — all in one place.

## Visual Resource Planning

Know what’s happening, who owns each task, and how work is spread across boards.

- See tasks by member and assign cards visually
- Understand who is working on what
- Keep the whole team plan clear and easy to follow

![powerup-store-2025-01-09-visual-resource-management.png](https://planyway.com/common/powerup-store-2025-01-09-visual-resource-management.png)

## Workload Management

Manage workload by estimates and capacity, spot overloads, and rebalance work early.

- See planned workload on daily, weekly, or monthly scales
- Balance tasks to fit each team member’s capacity
- Track total workload across the whole team

![powerup-store-2026-06-09-workload.png](https://planyway.com/common/powerup-store-2026-06-09-workload.png)

## Team Calendar

See your team’s schedule across all Trello boards in one calendar.

- View tasks and key milestones across boards in one place
- Drag-and-drop tasks without switching views
- Create, assign, and schedule subtasks seamlessly

![powerup-store-2025-01-09-centralize-your-schedule.png](https://planyway.com/common/powerup-store-2025-01-09-centralize-your-schedule.png)

## Time Blocking

Block time for real tasks and keep personal and team schedules in sync.

- See tasks from all projects on one unified view
- Integrate seamlessly with Google, Outlook, and other calendars
- Automate recurring tasks to save time and boost efficiency

![powerup-store-2025-01-09-centralize-your-schedule-2.png](https://planyway.com/common/powerup-store-2025-01-09-centralize-your-schedule-2.png)

## Time Tracking

Keep time records organized and generate timesheets from your schedule.

- Track time in Trello cards, List, or Calendar views
- Use a timer or add time manually
- Autogenerate timesheets from your schedule

![powerup-store-2025-01-09-effortless-time-tracking.png](https://planyway.com/common/powerup-store-2025-01-09-effortless-time-tracking.png)

## Reports and Analytics    

Turn time data into insights on project progress and team performance.

- Generate detailed reports across projects
- Compare tracked vs estimated time to optimize planning
- Export in Excel, CSV, PDF, and JSON

![powerup-store-2025-01-09-reports-and-analytics.png](https://planyway.com/common/powerup-store-2025-01-09-reports-and-analytics.png)

## Works where you work

Manage projects and track progress where your team already works.

![powerup-store-2025-01-09-plan-dates-and-track-time-where-you-work.png](https://planyway.com/common/powerup-store-2025-01-09-plan-dates-and-track-time-where-you-work.png)

## Packed with powerful features

‌

- **Multiboard View:** See everything in one place
- **Dependencies:** Manage task relationships
- **Recurring Cards:** Automate repeated tasks
- **Subtasks:** Break tasks into smaller parts
- **Easy Export:** Share with PDF, Excel, and CSV
- **Calendar Sync:** Works with Google, Outlook, and more

‌

# Helpful Links

‌

🎥 [On-Demand Product Demo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BUsIMD4bB10 "‌")
💡 [Best Use Cases](https://planyway.com/templates?utm_source=Cases&utm_medium=TrelloStore "‌")
📚 [Planyway Help Center](https://help.planyway.com/en/collections/3943319-planyway-for-trello "‌")

‌

Download our mobile apps for [iOS](https://apps.apple.com/ru/app/planyway-calendar-for-trello/id1398708038/ "‌") or [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rubius.planyway&hl=en "‌") to plan on the go.

‌

To get help, send us feedback or send us a feature request, please get in touch at [support@planyway.com](mailto:support@planyway.com "‌").

listing.name: Outlook Calendar for Trello by Kryl Solutions
listing.description:
## by [Kryl Solutions](https://kryl.com "‌")

![banner.png](https://kryl.com/apps/trello/outlook/images/banner.png)

🏆 **ACCOLADES**: [Fastest growing Power-Up in 2023](https://www.bluecatreports.com/blog/power-up-stats-2023/ "‌")

⭐️ **FEATURED**: By the [Trello Trailblazers](https://ace.atlassian.com/trello-trailblazers/ "‌") in

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=65tH5iEog3U](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=65tH5iEog3U "smartCard-embed")

‌

---

## Connect Your Outlook Calendar and Trello Work

Do your meetings live in Outlook while your work lives in Trello?

**Outlook Calendar for Trello (OCT)** brings both together in a single calendar view so you can see appointments, meetings, due dates, and tasks in one place.

Create Outlook appointments from Trello cards, or link Trello cards to your calendar appointments so every meeting has context and every task has a plan.

Whether you are planning work, preparing for meetings, or tracking deadlines, OCT helps reduce context switching and keeps your commitments connected.

[https://youtu.be/Ij2nfakuWrc](https://youtu.be/Ij2nfakuWrc "smartCard-embed")

![demo.png](https://kryl.com/apps/trello/outlook/images/demo.png)

> _OCT Calendar View with multiple Outlook accounts and calendars._

![card-in-appt.png](https://kryl.com/apps/trello/outlook/images/card-in-appt.png)

> _A linked Trello card displayed inside an Outlook appointment._

---

## What You Can Do

- View Outlook appointments and Trello cards together
- Create Outlook appointments directly from Trello cards
- Create Trello cards from the calendar view
- Link meetings and appointments to Trello cards
- Link multiple cards to a single meeting agenda
- Link multiple meetings to a single project card
- Switch between week and month calendar views
- Look ahead or behind across all of your work and commitments

**Basic functionality is free.**

---

## Premium Features

A premium subscription unlocks additional features:

- 🔔 Reminders
- ✏️ Edit existing appointments and cards
- ➕ Multiple Outlook accounts and calendars
- 🌈 Calendar colors
- 💬 Comment on linked Trello cards
- 👥 Share appointments with your team
- 🔗 Additional appointment and card linking options
- 📌 Past meeting badges and history

**All future Premium features are included with your subscription.**

---

## Subscription Options

### 👤 Personal

- Single Board — **$1/month** or **$10/year**
- All Boards — **$3/month** or **$30/year**

### 👥 Team

- Single Board — **$3/month** or **$29/year**

### 🏢 Enterprise

- Workspace — **$99/year**

Try Premium free for **14 days** with no credit card required.

👉 Visit our website For complete [licensing information](https://kryl.com/?page=licensing "‌").

---

## Commercial Usage

Boards with more than five users are considered commercial usage and may receive occasional notifications.

The Power-Up will continue functioning normally without a subscription, but subscribing removes commercial-use notifications and unlocks Premium features.

---

## IMPORTANT: Office 365 Consent

Many organizations require administrator approval before applications can access Outlook resources.

If you encounter a Microsoft consent or approval message, your organization may require one of the following:

- Administrator approval through the [Microsoft Office 365 admin consent process](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory/manage-apps/manage-consent-requests "‌")
- User justification through the [Microsoft Office 365 consent workflow](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory/manage-apps/admin-consent-workflow-overview "‌")

For more information:

👉 [Microsoft Office 365 Consent Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory/manage-apps/user-admin-consent-overview "‌")

---

## Protect Your Data

Kryl Solutions is committed to protecting your privacy.

We do not store your Outlook or Trello content and we never sell or share your personal information.

Learn more:

- [Privacy Policy](https://kryl.com/?page=/privacy "‌")
- [GDPR](https://kryl.com/?page=/gdpr "‌")

---

## 🔐 For IT and Cybersecurity Administrators

If your organization requires a security review, the following documentation is available:

- [Controls and Evidence](https://kryl.com/?page=/review "‌")
- [Data Flow](https://kryl.com/?page=/dataflow "‌")
- [Privacy Policy](https://kryl.com/?page=/privacy "‌")
- [GDPR](https://kryl.com/?page=/gdpr "‌")
- [Incident Response Plan](https://kryl.com/?page=irp "‌")
- [Encryption at Rest](https://kryl.com/?page=ear "‌")

---

## Support

📧 Questions, ideas, or issues: [Please contact us](https://kryl.com/?page=contact "‌")

listing.name: Repetidor de cartão
listing.description:
**Repita automaticamente tarefas recorrentes.**

O power-up Repetidor de cartão para o Trello automatiza a criação de cartões do Trello para tarefas recorrentes; assim, você tem uma coisa a menos com a qual se preocupar. Basta definir a agenda em um cartão para que o Trello crie automaticamente uma cópia exata desse cartão na data e na hora configuradas. Isso facilita o estabelecimento de um processo para tarefas semanais, retrospectivas, fechamentos contábeis mensais ou até mesmo um lembrete para que você não se esqueça de comprar o presente da sua mãe.

- Agende cartões para que se repitam diária, semanal, mensal ou anualmente.
- Os cartões serão copiados automaticamente para uma lista especificada.
- Crie um processo no seu fluxo de trabalho e garanta que nada seja esquecido.

![captura de tela](https://recurring-cards.trello.services/images/Card_Repeater_1.jpg)
